archetypes.name: dyn-bootstrap-routing
archetypes.rationale: BOOTSTRAP_NEXT centralizes Step 0 routing and resume-tail edge cases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the bootstrap routing changes around _bootstrap_next, continue_tail_attempted capture, and exit-0 envelope emission. Check precedence for degraded prompts, dirty recovery, blockers, malformed ROUTE after the absorbed 1.r tail, and resume coder restoration. Verify stdout and bootstrap-routing.env stay compatible with existing ROUTE consumers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-preflight-envelope
archetypes.rationale: Preflight now self-validates the seven-key success envelope before printing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the preflight success-envelope validator and row builder. Check duplicate and missing key handling, exact path comparisons, file readability checks, TITLE and RESUME validation, BYPASS_COUNT validation, and preservation of warning/prose output before the final envelope. Confirm helper non-zero exits and emergency bypass behavior are unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-skill-contract
archetypes.rationale: SKILL.md and shell pins now delegate residual routing and schema decisions to Python.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /implement SKILL.md prose and structural harness updates. Check that absorbed 1.r branches only on BOOTSTRAP_NEXT=rebase-routing, later checkpoints still branch on their foreground ROUTE output, Preflight item 3 is parse-only after Python validation, and Step 0 fails closed on absent or invalid BOOTSTRAP_NEXT without weakening section 2.1.5. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
